name: UpdatePrometheusAlertRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: alert_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the custom alert rule
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The notification type. Valid values:

`ALERT_MANAGER`: Notifications are sent through the alert operations center.
`DISPATCH_RULE`: Notifications are sent based on a specified notification policy
parameters.help_zh:
通知类型， 取值：

`ALERT_MANAGER`：通过告警运维中心通知。
`DISPATCH_RULE`：指定通知策略进行通知
parameters.name: notify_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the notification policy. This parameter is required when NotifyType is set to `DISPATCH_RULE`
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略ID，当NotifyType指定为`DISPATCH_RULE`时必填
parameters.name: dispatch_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The alert expression, which must be a PromQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 告警表达式，需要使用PromQL语句
parameters.name: expression

parameters.help_en: The duration. Valid values: 1m to 1440m. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 持续时间，范围在1m~1440m，单位为分钟
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The alert message. You can reference labels in the {{$labels.xxx}} format
parameters.help_zh: 告警消息，支持按照{{$labels.xxx}}格式来引用标签

parameters.help_en: The label JSON string. You must set the Name and Value of the label

parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The annotation JSON string. You must set the Name and Value of the annotation
parameters.help_zh: 注释JSON串。需要设置注释的Name和Value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alerting rule. You can obtain the ID from the response data of the ListPrometheusAlertRules API operation
